bias.label: Neutral on 4,075 support before jobs data

event: US jobs report Fri 6 Nov 15:30 SAST (65k expected, unemployment 4.2%)

bullets.title: Gave back gains
bullets.text: Gold is near 4,081-4,088 in early Friday trade (Trading Economics), down from Thursday's high near 4,147; exact quote time UNVERIFIED.

bullets.title: Lost 4,100
bullets.text: Spot gold slipped back under the 4,100 round number on Thursday afternoon, and Thursday's low was about 4,057.

bullets.title: Dollar still soft
bullets.text: The dollar index is near 101.6, close to a one-month low, and the US 10-year yield is about 4.84%.

bullets.title: Hike risk
bullets.text: CME FedWatch shows about 80% odds of a December Fed hike, which caps how far gold can run.

bullets.title: Risk-off selling
bullets.text: A global stock selloff led some traders to sell gold for cash, though gold is still on track for a weekly gain of over 5%.

bullets.title: Friday's test
bullets.text: The jobs report is today at 15:30 SAST, expected 65k with unemployment at 4.2%; a beat can push gold through 4,075 toward 4,000.

buy.title: Buy plan: with the bigger trend
look: A sweep below the Asia or London low that closes back above 4,068 on the 15M: your reclaim candle.
A 1H higher low above 4,068, so buyers are still defending support.
DXY staying near or under 101.6 and the 10-year yield under 4.9%.
Waiting until after 15:30 SAST if you are not already in, so the jobs data does not decide your trade.
watch: The jobs report at 15:30 SAST. A strong number can lift the dollar and break 4,057 fast.
Fed December hike odds near 80%. A strong jobs number can push them higher.
Buying just because price is 'cheap' after the drop. Wait for the reclaim candle.
Moving your stop lower when it gets close. That is how a small loss becomes a big one.

sell.title: Sell plan: counter-trend
look: A sweep above a session high near 4,135-4,147 that closes back below it on the 15M.
A 1H lower high under Thursday's 4,147 high.
A strong jobs report at 15:30 SAST.
A 4H close below 4,068 adds weight to the sell side, with 4,000 next.
watch: This sells against the bigger uptrend and a weekly gain of over 5%, so treat it as counter-trend. Consider half size.
